description: Energy Systems: from a bidding zone, country, balancing area or plant to published electricity generation by fuel, load, day-ahead prices, installed capacity and cross-border flows, plus energy balances, each with source, release vintage, publication status and as-of time (ENTSO-E, US EIA, Ember, Eurostat, Energy-Charts). Provisional and revised figures stay distinct; sources stay side by side. Composes climate-environment and market by citation.

profiles.description: Published-figure vocabulary for electricity and energy balances

vocabulary.vintage: one release of a series as its publisher states it
vocabulary.provisional: first or preliminary publication, may be revised
vocabulary.revised: a later publication that changes or confirms an earlier one
vocabulary.as_of: what was published at or before a time
